info.name: CosmicForge Real Estate
info.description: Official human-facing API handoff collection for CosmicForge Real Estate. OpenAPI remains the machine-readable contract. Requests are added only when the matching backend endpoint is implemented.

item.name: 00 Platform
item.description: Gateway/platform health, readiness and version endpoints. Edge behaviour common to all APIs: errors use the platform envelope (see examples), X-Request-ID is echoed, 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED / INVALID_TOKEN, 403 PERMISSION_DENIED for a token from another product, 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND (including any /internal path).

request.description: Liveness of the API Gateway. No authentication.
Readiness of the API Gateway; 503 while draining for shutdown.
Build metadata of the deployed gateway image.

item.name: 05 Artisan
item.description: Frontend-facing Artisan & Property Service Provider APIs.

item.name: 07 Admin
item.description: Admin product APIs. Keep privileged/internal operations clearly separated.

item.name: 08 Verification
item.description: Verification client-facing APIs. Internal/admin/webhook operations must live in dedicated subfolders.

request.description: Lists the signed-in user's own verification cases (subject = the user in their domain). Via the API Gateway.
Returns one of the user's own cases. Cases of other users (or the same ID in another product) return 404.

response.name: 401 Invalid token

request.description: Manual-review queue. Caller: admin-service with a delegated admin actor in the service token.
Assign to the acting admin. Caller: admin-service with a delegated admin actor in the service token.

response.name: 409 MANUAL_REVIEW_ASSIGNED_TO_OTHER

request.description: MANUAL_REVIEW → VERIFIED | REJECTED. Caller: admin-service with a delegated admin actor in the service token.
VERIFIED → EXPIRED. Caller: admin-service with a delegated admin actor in the service token.
Service-to-service. Creates a DRAFT case. Caller must be the subject domain's service and approved for the type.

response.name: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED
409 VERIFICATION_ALREADY_OPEN
409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

request.description: Attaches a media-document-service file (must belong to the subject's domain). DRAFT only.

response.name: 422 EVIDENCE_OWNER_MISMATCH
409 EVIDENCE_LOCKED

request.description: DRAFT → SUBMITTED. All evidence must be READY. Emits verification.submitted.v1.

response.name: 422 EVIDENCE_NOT_READY

request.description: SUBMITTED → PROCESSING. The provider is called asynchronously by the worker. Emits verification.processing.v1.
Cases for a subject, latest first.
Creates a new DRAFT superseding a VERIFIED, REJECTED or EXPIRED case.
Development/test provider callback via the API Gateway. X-Sandbox-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(raw body, SANDBOX_KYC_CALLBACK_SECRET). Duplicates return DUPLICATE.

item.name: 09 Payment
item.description: Payment APIs. Paystack remains reachable only through payment-service.

item.description: Notification APIs. Human-to-human messaging remains CF Meet.

item.description: Media/document APIs including signed upload/download flows.
